step_1.description: The consumer should first raise the electricity complaint with the relevant Distribution Company or Licensee.

step_2.authority: DISCO Consumer Service Center / concerned office
step_2.description: The consumer can use the Distribution Company's consumer complaint/service channels for issues such as billing, meter reading and electricity supply problems.

step_3.description: If the Distribution Company fails to redress the grievance or the complaint is unjustly turned down, the consumer may use the applicable NEPRA complaint process.

nepra_complaint_system.purpose: Register and track electricity consumer complaints.

information_useful_for_complaint: Details of the complaint already submitted to the Distribution Company

source.name: NEPRA Complaint Management System and Consumer Service Manual
